answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The anchor edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 24 clones produces a signature the terrace analysis flags immediately. Someone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the signal settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 24 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
